classification.difficultyReason: Use long division by twenty-five and interpret its quotient and remainder as full boxes and loose balls, as the two requested outputs indicate.

content.prompt: There are 5420 golf balls to be packed into boxes of 25. How many boxes will be filled and how many golf balls will be left over?

answer.short: 216 boxes will be filled; 20 golf balls will be left over.
